title: Karla Sofía Gascón on Her Villainous Turn in Western ‘Trinidad,’ the Flagship Title From Spain’s ISII
summary: The star discusses playing "a crippled, bitter villainess with a deep resentment toward progress" in her first big role since 'Emilia Pérez' and that Oscar season controversy, with CEO Silvia Carvalho touting the film as "distinctive" and a "statement" title heading into the company's first Cannes market.
